effect_description_eng:
You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 red Digimon for a memory cost of 2.
[When Digivolving] If a card with the [Hybrid] trait or [Takuya Kanbara] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.
